description: Sanity-check a vendor's or sender's domain before trusting an email, link or payment request. Measured at request time: A/AAAA, NS and MX records, SPF and DMARC policies, DNSSEC (DS), CAA, the TLS certificate on port 443 (issuer, validity, hostname match) and HTTPS security headers, with a list of risk flags. Technical signals only, not a reputation or ownership verdict. Use when an unfamiliar domain appears in an invoice, email or supplier record. $0.003 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com (no scheme or path)

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: domain_check
